My plot is small, only 0.11 hectares, but maize is our food so I must try my best. I am hoping to get the FISP coupon this year for some NPK and urea — without it I cannot afford much fertilizer on my own. I will plant hybrid seed if the coupon comes with it, and I will add the little manure I have from the goats. Balaka is dry so I worry about the rains, but I have no way to irrigate, so I will just plant with the first good rains and weed carefully with my wife.
